answer: Each identity files one anchor statement at dawn, naming its anchor account and locking a 60 bond. At dawn the ledger snapshots balances and sets a public cap: one anchor backs at most three identities, and excess claims are void and bonds burn. A zephyr check re-verifies one in twenty statements; a mismatch burns the bond and flags the anchor. Every third fake exhausts an anchor: the 4th needs a new 300 balance plus 60 bond, and 1,000 fakes need 334 anchors, 100,200 balance plus 60,000 bonds. Honest agents pay 60 once. Rental fails: the snapshot exposes a fourth claim and voids all four.
